Good morning, Ms. Arnia,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and the delay regarding this matter. We completely understand your concern and truly appreciate your patience and understanding.

Please be assured that we have already informed the concerned team regarding the payment matter. As it is currently the weekend and our Finance Team is unavailable, we kindly request your understanding and allow us until Monday to arrange and settle the payment.

Once the payment has been processed, the Upside Team will be able to assist you further regarding the TV.

We genuinely apologize for the delay and any inconvenience this may have caused you. We will follow up with the team on Monday and keep you updated as soon as we have confirmation.

Thank you once again for your patience, understanding, and kind cooperation.
